title: Phaseolus Vulgaris Uses, Benefits, And Remedies
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris, commonly known as the common bean, is a flowering plant in the legume family, widely cultivated for its edible seeds. This herb is rich in nutrients such as protein, fiber, and various vitamins and minerals, offering health benefits like improved digestion, blood sugar regulation, and cardiovascular support. The bioactive constituents in Phaseolus vulgaris include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. Herbal preparations such as infusions, decoctions, and powders can be made from the seeds or leaves to harness its medicinal properties.
